hints.title: Square-Free Core Invariant
hints.text: Two 1-based indices i and j have i * j being a perfect square if and only if they share the exact same square-free core.

hints.title: Index Decomposition
hints.text: Every index can be written uniquely as c * d^2 where c is square-free and d >= 1.

hints.title: Independent Core Sums
hints.text: For each square-free base c from 1 up to n, sum nums[c * d^2 - 1] for all d >= 1 such that c * d^2 <= n, and take the global maximum.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sum of n/d^2 over d >= 1 is bounded by n * pi^2 / 6 = O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all complete subsets naively takes exponential time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose into square-free base classes with linear harmonic sum.
